tesseract.js 7.0.0, self-hosted so the site makes no request outside its own origin.

Every file is byte-identical to the one in the npm package named below. Each package tarball was fetched with `npm pack <name>@<version>` from the
npm registry, and its sha512 matched the registry's dist.integrity. Files were copied out of the extracted tarball into this folder, unmodified.
To update: pack the new versions the same way, replace the files, rewrite this list (`sha256sum` of every file), and run `npm test`.

LICENSE here is the tesseract.js license, followed by the tesseract.js-core license and a note on the language models.

Why only these files: friend-scan.js starts the worker with the default OCR engine mode (LSTM only), so tesseract.js asks for the three "-lstm" core builds
(plain, SIMD, relaxed SIMD; it picks one by what the browser supports) and the "4.0.0_best_int" language files. The legacy engine's cores and models, the
non-LSTM builds, the UMD bundle and the source maps are not needed and were left out.
Paths are set in web/friend-scan.js (workerPath, corePath, langPath). The library's own defaults point at cdn.jsdelivr.net and are never used.
